comment: The static registry site catalog (tool/build_registry_site.sh merges this with the compiled distributable plugins). source: 'included' entries are documentation for plugins compiled into the tina binary - no artifact, not installable; 'planned' entries document what is coming.

included.name: tina/providers
included.description: Provider policy and model selection: settings, model catalog, endpoint wiring.

included.name: tina/approvals
included.description: The asking boundary for tool commands: approvals, prefix/exact rules, directory grants.

included.name: tina/system-instruction
included.description: Assembles the system instruction from mode, workspace context and policy.

included.name: tina/mode
included.description: Agent modes (chat / plan / yolo semantics) and mode switching.

included.name: tina/tools
included.description: The portable tool set: read, write, glob, grep, bash, exec with the sandbox boundary.

included.name: tina/tasks
included.description: The task queue: follow-up tasks, current/pending/done/skipped states.

included.name: tina/activity-tui
included.description: Activity stream projection for the TUI (tool runs, results, lifecycle).

included.name: tina/approvals-stream
included.description: Streams approval requests to attached front ends over the pipes protocol.

included.name: tina/chat-tui
included.description: The chat surface: transcript, streaming replies, input line.

included.name: tina/grok-guard
included.description: Reply guardrails: refusal detection and safety policy enforcement.

included.name: tina/session-controls
included.description: Session lifecycle commands: resume, fork, rewind, list.

included.name: tina/token-rate-tui
included.description: Token usage and rate telemetry panel.

included.name: tina/context
included.description: Working context assembly for prompts: file mirror summaries, focus files.

planned.name: tina/update-tui
planned.description: Self-update UI for the TUI. Planned: requires the host update interface (separate thread); will ship here when the host side lands.
